store.notes: In this release, we fixed a few bugs and made several performance improvements.

themes.label: Misleading Advertising
themes.describe: Several reviews state that the results do not match the high-quality examples shown in the App Store.

quotes.title: Are the images shown from this app?
quotes.text: At least two of the images shown by the seller for this app display painting effects that are not in the app, at least not in the app I have received. …

gists: App results do not match the high-quality marketing images shown.

themes.label: Limited Content/Filters
themes.describe: Users frequently complain that the number of available filters or effects is too small or basic.

quotes.title: No thanks
quotes.text: Just a few boring cartoon-style effects, either real-time or applied to photos in your Camera Roll. Not worth taking up space on my iPad.

quotes.title: Do not buy !
quotes.text: I spent two dollars on this , because I thought it was a cartoon editor. This app doesn’t have no menu or edit tools. It only has 4 filters and they are all low quality. …

quotes.title: Don’t buy this!!
quotes.text: This app should be free with its limited filters! Give me my $1.99 back!

gists: Effects are boring and limited; not worth keeping on the device.
App has few, low-quality filters and no editing tools.
Wants a refund because the app's filters are limited.
Many free apps offer similar functionality; limited unique effects.
Effects are basic and don't match advertised results.
Disappointed; feels like it is not worth the cost due to few filters.
Output is blurry; needs filter adjustment and more options.
Filters are limited, and marketing examples are misleading.
Filters are basic, controls are hard to use, and free options exist.
Too few options available; user regrets paying for the app.

themes.label: No Fine-Tuning Controls
themes.describe: A major recurring complaint is the inability to adjust the intensity or parameters of the applied effects.

quotes.title: Not even close to the pics in the App Store
quotes.text: The images don't come out as good as it shows in the App Store samples. They are a lot more cartoonist/distorted. The app lacks the function to adjust the intensity of the filter. …

quotes.title: Don’t buy
quotes.text: Ugh. Nothing like what I wanted. It distorts the picture too much to be able to use it. There needs to be an option to make the lines in the filters smaller.

quotes.title: Disappointed
quotes.text: It does not work like promised. It is simply filters that you can get anywhere. Not a realistic cartoon like it shows. …

gists: Output is worse than samples; needs filter intensity adjustment slider.
Distorts pictures too much; needs smaller filter line options.
Does not work as advertised; lacks filter intensity control.

themes.label: Photo Import Restriction
themes.describe: Users are frustrated that the app only allows taking new photos and cannot edit existing ones from the camera roll.

quotes.title: Blah
quotes.text: Donated 2 Bucks! I wanted to use this with pics from my camera roll, however when I select a picture there are no options for anything, except the option to Save the photo I already had. …

quotes.title: You can’t use old photos
quotes.text: You can only take new pics - can’t stylize old photos. Do not recommend waste of money

quotes.title: Does not work
quotes.text: Just bought this app and won’t let me load all my photos to edit, just a few here and there but only about 10% of my camera roll. Avoid this scam

gists: Cannot use photos from camera roll; options are missing.
Cannot apply effects to existing photos from the camera roll.
App won't load most photos from the camera roll for editing.
App only opens camera and cannot use existing photos from the album.

themes.label: Low Resolution/Blurriness
themes.describe: Users report that the final output images or videos are blurry, low resolution, or distorted.

quotes.title: Don’t buy
quotes.text: Ugh. Nothing like what I wanted. It distorts the picture too much to be able to use it. There needs to be an option to make the lines in the filters smaller.

quotes.title: Terrible!
quotes.text: Most basic photo app I’ve used. Edits look like original ones for any phone years ago. Wish I could get my money back to be honest. Don’t make the same mistake I did

quotes.title: Do not buy !
